messages.author: 7b20822d294da1b2
messages.subject: Re: Package installing in library default and temporary folders
parts:
Hi Eva,

You don't need to do the 
load(micromap) 
step. The
library(micromap)
step loads all of the functions from the micromap package if you have installed the packages correctly. For example, before you did the library() step, you wouldn't be able to access the create_map_table() function that comes with micromap. 
What are you trying to do? Are you trying to just load the functions? Or are you trying to run a protocol? Or trying to access a dataset? Once you run the library() command above, you should be able to run command like 
data(edPov)
to access the edPov dataset, or substitute another dataset name in the command above to load it.

Hope this helps

Katie
